description: No API key, no login. Address to coordinates and back from 10 official government address registers: US Census, Canada NRCan, UK ONS postcodes, France BAN, Spain CartoCiudad, Netherlands BAG, Switzerland, Norway, Estonia, Poland. Open licences: you may store the results. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.003/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/official-geocoding-api.

addressColumn.description: Optional: the CSV header that holds the full address, e.g. 'Shipping address'. Leave empty to detect it.

addresses.description: Addresses, postcodes or place names, up to 5,000 per run (see Max items; long lists run in chunks of 100). The country is detected from the text (postcode format, city or country name). To force it, set Country below or prefix one line like

coordinates.description: Optional points as 'lat,lon', e.g. 52.3759,4.8975. Returns the nearest official address (FR, ES, NL, NO, PL), the nearest postcode (GB) or the county and census tract (US).

country.description: Optional: one country for all lines (US, CA, GB, FR, ES, NL, CH, NO, EE, PL). Leave 'auto' to detect it per line.

csvUrl.description: Optional public link to a CSV, TSV or text file with addresses, e.g. a Google Sheet published as CSV (File > Share > Publish to web > CSV). The address column is found by name (address, full_address, location...), or street/city/state/zip c

includeCensus.description: For US addresses also return state, county and census tract FIPS codes (GEOID) from the Census Bureau. Useful for demographics joins, insurance and lending (HMDA/CRA) work.

maxItems.description: Most addresses + points processed in one run (1-5,000). About 1,000 addresses take 2-4 minutes; results are saved as they come, so a timeout keeps what was done.
